│  grants or funding opportunities.                                        │

│  logistics.                                                              │
│                                                                          │

│  community centers, social media platforms, and events to attract        │
│  participants.                                                           │

│  Connect with businesses, schools, and other organizations for support   │
│  and supply donation.                                                    │

│  - Community Engagements                                                 │
│  - Networking & Partnership Building                                     │
│                                                                          │

│  - Initial agreements with stakeholders established by End of Week 8.    │

│  containers in public spaces like parks, schools, and commercial         │
│  centers.                                                                │

│  monthly collection drives and educational workshops to engage the       │
│  community.                                                              │

│  - Facility Management                                                   │
│  - Event Planning                                                        │
│                                                                          │

│  - First collection event completed by End of Week 11.                   │
│  - Educational programs initiated in Week 12.                            │

│  strategies as needed.                                                   │

│  - Survey Design & Execution                                             │
